prompt: Edit the original into compact Japanese Lighthouse image-crop plus related-results component, using native Japanese mock for two-result scope and wording only. Preserve all three protected TULIP PHOTOGRAPHS exactly: original top coral tulip photo with blurred green/red backdrop, lower-left close-up stem/yellow-base/coral petals, lower-right pink/orange/yellow tulip and green backdrop INCLUDING original white 'Branded Garden Products Ltd' watermark. Do not redraw flowers, change crop/lighting/petal edges, replace textures, remove watermark or invent new images. Main top photograph has original offset crop rectangle: left edge ~23% across, right near95%, top near8%, bottom atphoto edge, thin white connecting edges with four THICK rounded L-corner handles. Dim image outside crop rectangle as original. White X on translucent black rounded square at bottom-right of photo. Match original crop bounds and overlapping handle/X positions; do not center crop. Below main photo, white rounded-top sheet with small centered dark horizontal drag handle (restore; mock omitted), then two tabs exact '探索' and '商品', Meiryo Regular14/24; 商品 selected with short dark-green underline, neither tab bold. Below exactly TWO complete result cards as Japanese mock scope, left landscape photo, right taller square photo, both original crops, modest rounded corners and narrow gutter. Small white top-left price badges exact '￥2,800' and '￥1,500', Regular12/16 dark. Below left text '花の写真のアイデア', small original horizontal three-dot menu at right. Below right photo place restrained forest-green caption band '花の写真' in white Regular12/16, WITHOUT covering or removing photo watermark; then text '季節の花を見つける' and three-dot menu. Preserve image portions above labels. White outer surfaces, body ink #1D1D1D/meta#6E6E6E, utility slate#526173, green only small selected underline and authored caption. No big green panels, no shadows, no phone chrome or new title. Tight white margins, compact mock proportions, complete cards. Do not include partial third-row card outside this native two-card component scope. Original fine media, crop controls, sheet handle, result ellipsis and watermark are authoritative.
reviewNotes: Crop corners/X, drag handle, selected Shop tab, result menus and original watermark retained. All three protected photos show reconstructed petal textures and lower-right photo vertical crop/aspect drift; Regular tab requirement also heavier. Try new bounded original-only text replacement with no layout reconstruction to protect media; retain v1.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
